subject: Strategic workshop — cost-share, booking exemption, and timelines
messages:
From: Ruth Sanders <ruth.sanders@northstarhealth.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic workshop — travel exceptions and logistics

Hi Aditya and Laura,

Thanks again for working with Northstar on the May 24–26 strategic workshop. A quick ask from our side: our CPO and VP of Product will be traveling from Chicago and require premium seating due to medical restrictions and back-to-back meetings on day 1. Our procurement team prefers all bookings to go through our PO process, but given the short lead time we need confirmation that Redwood can:

- Approve two premium-economy/business seats as a one-time exception, billed to the deal (we can cost-share if needed).
- Confirm hotel early check-in for two senior attendees on the 23rd.
- Provide a single consolidated invoice to procurement@northstarhealth.com.

I've attached the latest MAP and the provisional participant list for names and titles. Our target is to finalize bookings by EOB Wednesday (May 12) to lock fares. Could you confirm coverage and next steps? If there are forms we need to sign for an exception, please point me to them.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Ruth

Attachments: northstar_map_v4.pdf, participants_list.csv

Ruth Sanders
Head of Procurement
Northstar Health
Ruth.Sanders@northstarhealth.com
(312) 555-0183
From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Ruth Sanders <ruth.sanders@northstarhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Strategic workshop — travel exceptions and logistics

Ruth — thanks for the details and the MAP. Confirming receipt and quick notes below.

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 09:12 AM Ruth Sanders <ruth.sanders@northstarhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for working with Northstar on the May 24–26 strategic workshop. A quick ask from our side: our CPO and VP of Product will be traveling from Chicago and require premium seating due to medical restrictions and back-to-back meetings on day 1.

Short version: we can accommodate a one-time seating upgrade for two senior attendees and cover early check-in for two rooms. We’ll treat this as an approved exception on the NW-4932 deal subject to:

1) A signed one-time travel exception form (I’ve attached a draft cost estimate and the exception template for quick sign-off).
2) A PO or billing instruction from procurement to send a consolidated invoice.
3) Cost-share plan — Redwood will cover 60% of the incremental fare/hotel early-check-in; Northstar covers 40% and provides PO reference.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll get Finance (Marcus) to confirm GL codes and sign-off.
- Laura, can you engage travel ops to get firm fares and hold inventory for two premium seats?
- Ruth, please send full passenger names and any special meal/assist requests by EOD Tuesday so we can confirm.

Attaching: cost_estimate_draft.xlsx (ballpark numbers).

Thanks — Aditya

Aditya Rao
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
From: Ruth Sanders <ruth.sanders@northstarhealth.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Strategic workshop — travel exceptions and logistics

Thanks Aditya — names below and PO info so procurement can route invoice correctly.

Passenger details (for the two premium seats):
- David Chen, CPO — dietary: vegetarian, medical note attached to his profile
- Laura Vega, VP Product — dietary: none

PO: NSH-PO-8721 (please put this on the invoice). Billing contact is procurement@northstarhealth.com.

I've attached an updated participant list with titles and arrival/departure windows. We can accept the 60/40 cost-share as long as the invoice clearly shows the split and Redwood’s portion is credited to the deal.

Forwarding for clarity: I can sign the exception form electronically if you send the DocuSign link.

Ruth

Attachments: updated_participant_list.csv
From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Ruth Sanders <ruth.sanders@northstarhealth.com>, procurement@northstarhealth.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Strategic workshop — travel exceptions and logistics

Team — finalizing approvals and booking instructions.

- Approval: Marcus, Finance approves the one-time exception under deal NW-4932 and confirms Redwood will cover 60% of incremental travel/hotel early-check-in costs.
- Booking: Laura — please instruct travel ops to proceed with the two premium seats and early check-in holds for the rooms on May 23. Use the G/L code 5002-STRAT (Marcus to confirm final PO allocation).
- Invoicing: send consolidated invoice to procurement@northstarhealth.com with PO NSH-PO-8721 and line-items showing Northstar vs Redwood contributions.
- Sign-off: Ruth, I’ve initiated a DocuSign for the one-time travel exception and attached the signed internal approval PDF for our records. Please complete the DocuSign by EOD Monday so travel can lock fares.

Documents attached: redwood_exception_form_signed.pdf (internal approval), cost_estimate_draft.xlsx (updated with final numbers).

Thanks all — we’ll confirm PNRs once booked.

Aditya Rao
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
